explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/976: F_f(n) is the greatest prime divisor of ∏_{m≤n} f(m) for irreducible f ∈ ℤ[x] of degree d ≥ 2.  is maxPrimeFac of |∏_{m∈[1,n]} f(m)|; there are no integer roots, so the product is nonzero. Erdős improved the bound to F_f(n) ≫ n(log n)^{log log log n}. The docstring notes that [Er52c] actually has a constant c = c(f) in the exponent, and the statement uses ∃ c > 0 with n(log n)^{c log log log n} = O(F f n). That faithfully represents the published result.
